rav-dimi-achuha-derav-safra.name: Rav Dimi, brother of Rav Safra
rav-dimi-achuha-derav-safra.bio: Babylonian Amora, the brother of Rav Safra.
rav-dimi-achuha-derav-safra.prompt: A gentle Babylonian scholar in his 60s with a soft grey beard and a plain wool mantle, propped on cushions as if receiving a visiting brother; background of mudbrick walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-anani-bar-sason.name: Rabbi Anani bar Sason
rabbi-anani-bar-sason.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who taught that each of the priestly vestments atones for a particular sin.
rabbi-anani-bar-sason.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a plain linen mantle, counting on his fingers as he lists the priestly garments; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

rabbi-simon.name: Rabbi Simon
rabbi-simon.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who often transmits teachings of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi.
rabbi-simon.prompt: A composed scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a wool mantle, repeating his teacher’s words with a raised hand; background of limestone arches in a Galilean study hall.

rabbi-shmuel-bar-nadav.name: Rabbi Shmuel bar Nadav
rabbi-shmuel-bar-nadav.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel; some reports call him the son-in-law of Rabbi Ḥanina.
rabbi-shmuel-bar-nadav.prompt: An earnest scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a plain mantle, leaning forward to put a question to an elder; background of olive trees and limestone walls in Sepphoris.

rabbi-elazar-ben-azaria.name: Rabbi Elazar ben Azaria
rabbi-elazar-ben-azaria.bio: Tanna of Yavne, a wealthy kohen of distinguished lineage who was appointed Nasi while still young, in place of Rabban Gamliel.
rabbi-elazar-ben-azaria.prompt: A young kohen of about 18 whose full beard has turned white, as tradition tells, wearing fine white linen robes with a dignified bearing; background of the Yavne study hall.

rabbi-yehuda-brei-derabbi-shimon.name: Rabbi Yehuda son of Rabbi Shimon
rabbi-yehuda-brei-derabbi-shimon.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, usually identified as the son of Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi.
rabbi-yehuda-brei-derabbi-shimon.prompt: A young scholar in his 20s with a light beard and a simple linen mantle, asking his father a question with an open, searching expression; background of Galilean limestone arches.

mar-bereih-deravina.name: Mar son of Ravina
mar-bereih-deravina.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Ravina, whose personal prayer “My God, guard my tongue from evil” closes the Amida.
mar-bereih-deravina.prompt: A pious Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and a plain dark mantle, standing in quiet prayer with lowered eyes; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rava-zeeira.name: Rava the Younger
rava-zeeira.bio: Amora named in the Aramaic as Rava Ze’eira, “Rava the Younger.”
rava-zeeira.prompt: A lean scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a plain wool mantle, raising an objection with a wry look; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.
